lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And then he stabbed her inside the truck.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And he told you put the truck in the pit?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And how did he get the truck in the pit again, tell me that.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Chuck's way, Chuck's, past Chuck's house.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did he say if Chuck seen him?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did he say if anybody else saw him?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did he tell you what he was gonna do with her truck?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: He might crush it or start it on fire?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did he tell you how he got her bloody clothes?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
